Name: Cathy Rahder
Badge: Everyday Sparks 2.0
Which strategy from this module (Daily Schedule, Take a Line for a Walk or Interpreting Visual Texts) feels most immediately usable in your teaching context? Why?:

Interpreting Visual Texts feels most immediately usable. I use composition notebooks daily, but I have never done anything like reading a visual before. My kids loved it, and it showed me how deep kids can think when asked.

What other strategies or approaches have you used to engage your students in routine writing over the course of this school year? What, if any, challenges have you encountered in engaging students in sustained routine writing?:
The compostion notebook is my biggest impementation. I also make it madatory for my kids to annotate text when testing. I have encouraged my kids to make their notes fun and pretty by allowing them to use markers and such while annotating. It has opened a whole new world, and the kids scores have improved.
